fixes.now: and held that repair invoices could corroborate testimony of payment but, with no qualified witness authenticating them as accurate records, could not be used to prove the specific work actually performed.

fixes.was: Under New York law, a contract that unambiguously transfers unconditional ownership of a work carries the right to exploit it in any manner unless the grantor expressly reserves rights; silence about a particular use does not create an ambiguity.
fixes.now: Under New York law, a clear, complete writing is enforced according to its terms, and silence about a particular use does not make an unconditional transfer of ownership ambiguous or reserve that use to the grantor.

fixes.now: The court relied on Pushman, Burnett, and Boosey & Hawkes, the last of which placed the responsibility for negotiating an exception on the party seeking it.
